text: Closing. At the eyes4s pin 56506d28, which is on intaglio origin/main, every item is present: the scalar raster geom (PlotDsl.geomRaster with RasterGeomSuite); the colour-bar legend (ScalarLegend with ScalarLegendSuite); lossless PNG embedding in SVG (RasterGeomSvgSuite); and the PDF backend intaglio-pdf with lossless image XObjects (RasterGeomPdfSuite). The upstream bead bd-01M3F1A70MG8CTEWF114T3SRAJ is closed. PDF text needs embeddable fonts (PdfFont.load); S9.3 has to wire that up.
